changes: First library release for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, on core-ar2 0.3. The FILTER page's FRQ popup shows the cutoff in hertz.
Source-only export compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/filter-hz; elekloader kit 0.7.0 links it with the released core-ar2 0.3 on stock 1.74 into the hardware-tested FZ74 .syx byte for byte.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
